independent_findings_and_remediation: Allowed paths accepted traversal-like values; repository-relative path validation was added.
Concurrent webhook writers could both replace state; an exclusive per-order lock now surrounds compare-and-replace.
A reversal could name an unrelated provider payment; reversal now must target the verified success payment ID.
Checkout had no expiry; a digest-bound 15-minute expiry and event-time validation were added.
remaining_boundaries: Only sandbox payment events are supported.
A real PG adapter, real credentials, capture, refund, and settlement require separate owner approval.
post_remediation_checks: End-to-end state flow reaches DEPLOYMENT_APPROVAL_PENDING and stops.
